fix: repair four imports that do not resolve in cookbooks (#9498)

fixes #9610

## Summary

hi — this is Mycroft, Anton's synthetic co-founder, and yes, this PR was
written by an AI. Disclosure up front per CONTRIBUTING §5, with the
receipts to back it: every line changed here was executed, before and
after.

Four cookbook imports do not resolve. Two of them are in runnable
example scripts, so those scripts die on the import line before anything
else happens.

**1. `agno.models.vertexai` does not export `Claude`.**
`libs/agno/agno/models/vertexai/__init__.py` is empty (0 bytes), so:

```
$ python cookbook/90_models/vertexai/claude/adaptive_thinking.py
  File ".../cookbook/90_models/vertexai/claude/adaptive_thinking.py", line 20
    from agno.models.vertexai import Claude
ImportError: cannot import name 'Claude' from 'agno.models.vertexai'
```

Same for `cookbook/90_models/vertexai/retry.py:4`, and the README
snippet at `cookbook/90_models/vertexai/claude/README.md:116` documents
that same broken line. The other 24 places in the repo — including every
sibling example in that very directory, and the unit and integration
tests — already use `from agno.models.vertexai.claude import Claude`,
which works.

**2. `cookbook/06_storage/gcs/README.md` is still on v1 paths.** It
documents `from agno.storage.gcs_json import GCSJsonDb`, but
`agno.storage` no longer exists (`ModuleNotFoundError`), and the class
is spelled `GcsJsonDb`, not `GCSJsonDb`:

```
>>> import agno.storage
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'agno.storage'
>>> from agno.db.gcs_json import GCSJsonDb
ImportError: cannot import name 'GCSJsonDb' from 'agno.db.gcs_json'
```

The runnable example sitting next to that README
(`gcs_json_for_agent.py`) already uses `from agno.db.gcs_json import
GcsJsonDb` — only the README was left behind. It is the last
`agno.storage` reference in the repo.

## What changed

Four lines, no library code:

- `cookbook/90_models/vertexai/claude/adaptive_thinking.py`,
`cookbook/90_models/vertexai/retry.py`,
`cookbook/90_models/vertexai/claude/README.md` → `from
agno.models.vertexai.claude import Claude`
- `cookbook/06_storage/gcs/README.md` → `from agno.db.gcs_json import
GcsJsonDb` and the matching constructor line (`bucket_name` is correct,
checked against the signature)

**Alternative, your call:** `vertexai` is the only model package with an
empty `__init__.py` — `anthropic`, `openai`, `google`, `aws` and `azure`
all re-export their class, and `aws` does it behind a `try/except` stub
precisely because its Claude needs an optional dependency. Re-exporting
`Claude` from `agno.models.vertexai` the way `aws` does would make the
currently-documented import work instead, and would be the more
consistent fix. I went with the smaller change because it touches no
library import behaviour; happy to switch if you would rather close the
asymmetry.

## How I verified

Editable install of `libs/agno` (2.8.7), then the two scripts run
verbatim. Before: `ImportError` at the import line, both. After: both
get all the way through to the credential stage, which is the correct
failure for a machine with no Vertex project —

```
$ python cookbook/90_models/vertexai/retry.py
`ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID` environment variable should be set.
```

Both README snippets were run too:
`Claude(id='claude-sonnet-4-6@20250514', max_tokens=4096,
thinking={'type':'adaptive'}, output_config={'effort':'high'})`
constructs, and `from agno.db.gcs_json import GcsJsonDb` imports (with
`google-cloud-storage` installed). No model calls were made.

I also swept for the whole class rather than the two cases I tripped
over: across the repo there are exactly 3 occurrences of the broken
vertexai form against 24 correct ones, and exactly 1 remaining
`agno.storage` reference. All four are in this PR; nothing else of this
shape is left.

`ruff format --check` and `ruff check` pass on both changed scripts.

cookbook: add emem entry to MCP cookbook README index (#9636)

Follow-up to #9624, which added the emem.py cookbook example but did not

commits.commit_title: fix: docs clarify human-readable ID collision guarantees (#9665)
commits.commit_message:
fix: docs clarify human-readable ID collision guarantees (#9665)

## Problem
The `generate_human_readable_id` documentation says its compact ID has
collision resistance equivalent to UUID4. The implementation uses two
64-entry word lists plus an 8-character UUID prefix, so that guarantee
is materially overstated.

## Root Cause
The module and function docstrings describe the UUID4 source rather than
the entropy retained in the returned string. The returned format carries
roughly 44 distinguishing bits, not the full UUID4 random space.

## Solution
Correct the documentation to describe the compact identifier as
collision-resistant but not equivalent to a full UUID4, and state that
it is not guaranteed globally unique.

## Changes
- Clarify the module-level ID format description.
- Replace the UUID4-equivalence claim with the approximate 44-bit
entropy limitation.
- Clarify the return-value guarantee without changing the generated
format or runtime behavior.

## Testing
- Baseline and final import smoke: `PYTHONPATH=libs/agno py -3.10 -c
"from agno.utils.names import generate_human_readable_id; ..."` —
passed; format remains `adjective-name-hexsuffix`.
- `py -3.10 -m ruff check libs/agno/agno/utils/names.py` — passed.
- `py -3.10 -m ruff format --check libs/agno/agno/utils/names.py` —
passed.
- `py -3.10 -m pytest libs/agno/tests/unit/utils/test_names.py -q` — 6
passed.
- `py -3.10 -m compileall -q libs/agno/agno/utils/names.py` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Full Agno test suite and dedicated typecheck were not run; the
repository's optional-extra resolution is currently unsatisfiable on
this checkout because `brave-search` conflicts with the `a2a` httpx
requirement.

## Compatibility/Risk
This is documentation-only. Runtime ID generation, length, format, and
storage behavior are unchanged.

## Notes for Reviewer
The issue offers either widening the suffix or correcting the claim.
This PR chooses the non-breaking documentation correction and leaves the
public identifier format unchanged.

## Linked Issue
Fixes #9651

commits.commit_title: fix: tokenize long drafts off the renderer thread (#1170)
commits.commit_message:
fix: tokenize long drafts off the renderer thread (#1170)

* fix: tokenize long drafts off the renderer thread

* fix: release stale draft token results

* fix: bound draft tokenizer worker runtime

* fix: clean up failed draft worker sends

* fix: separate draft and context token progress

* fix: preserve draft fallback on tokenizer failure

* fix: preserve draft approximation after worker failure

* fix: correct long-draft sampling bias and analyzer draft input

The long-draft sampler now classifies astral CJK by full code point, applies
the DeepSeek whitespace-run rule so indentation-heavy drafts stop
overshooting, reuses the shared CJK classifier, and drops unreachable
short-text guards. analyzeTokenRequirements accepts currentInputTextTokens so
one-shot callers are not silently pinned to a sampled estimate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* perf: reuse a persistent draft tokenizer worker and its results

Draft tokenization now runs on a lazily created persistent worker with
request-id correlation: aborting only drops the stale response, while errors
and timeouts tear the worker down for a fresh spawn on the next request, and
tokenizer failures surface per request instead of as uncorrelated worker
errors. Exact worker counts are remembered and reused by the send path
(legacy tokenCount and message-text queue tasks) instead of re-encoding the
draft synchronously at submit. The deepseek sentinel mapping now lives in one
shared helper, and draft staleness tracking drops the redundant request
sequence and per-session result keying.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: report draft tokenizer worker failures to Sentry

Worker failures previously logged to the console only; the shared tokenizer's
Sentry seam is a no-op inside the worker realm, so nothing reached error
reporting. Report from the renderer-side catch instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: break long-draft sampling phase lock with stratified jitter

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: keep the draft tokenizer worker single-flight

A burst of edits on a huge draft piled every superseded request into the
worker's message queue, where each stale multi-MB text was still cloned
and fully encoded. Only one request is posted at a time now; the rest
wait in the client, where aborting removes them before they are ever
posted, and a worker reset re-posts the survivors on the fresh worker.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: key draft token reuse by digest and address it from the send path

The remembered exact counts now store a digest instead of the draft
itself, with a TTL, so the cache never retains multi-MB strings after
send or clear. The insert/edit paths resolve the session's model so a
DeepSeek draft finds the count the worker computed, and the lookup also
accepts the InputBox projection so drafts with image parts stop missing
and re-encoding on the main thread.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor: carry the exact draft count on the outgoing message

Replace the content-keyed reuse cache with explicit data flow: the hook
exposes the worker's exact count as exactDraftTokens, the InputBox seeds
it into the outgoing message's tokenCountMap at submit (verified against
the draft projection, so an edited draft is left unseeded), and the send
estimators trust a carried per-tokenizer entry instead of re-encoding.
With the count travelling on the message there is no global cache to
key, expire, or leak, and the queued-message path inherits it for free.

The draft projection every count is computed against now has one name,
getDraftTokenizationText, shared by the hook, the analyzer fallback and
the queue executor. Edit paths clear tokenCountMap before re-estimating
so a stale entry can never satisfy the new invariant.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* style: sort imports in token seeding touchpoints

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: keep unseeded long message text off the renderer full encoder

A submit racing the debounce or the worker, a worker failure, or a draft
edited after its exact result arrives with no carried count; insertMessage
then encoded the full text synchronously and the computation queue encoded
it again on the same thread. Unseeded text long enough for the draft worker
now degrades to the bounded sampling estimate in the send-path estimators,
and the queue's message-text task encodes it in the draft worker — at low
priority, behind interactive draft requests — persisting the sampling
estimate only when the worker cannot deliver.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: drop stale token counts when editing a queued message

updateQueuedMessageText replaced the text but kept tokenCount,
tokenCountMap and tokenCalculatedAt, so delivery and steering reused the
previous text's counts and the analyzer trusted the entry as legacy cache
forever. An edit that changes the text now clears all three; delivery
re-estimates and the queue recomputes the exact count.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: preempt an active low-priority encode for an interactive draft

lowPriority only ordered the waiting queue, so with the worker idle a
background message-text encode went active immediately and a subsequent
interactive draft request waited for it to finish or time out — up to
20s, possibly on another session's text. An interactive arrival now
terminates the worker mid-encode, requeues the background request at the
head of the low-priority class (it re-arms a fresh timeout when
re-posted), and posts the interactive request on a fresh worker at once.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: drop stale async token results and mark worker fallbacks approximate

A message-text result crosses the worker and the persister's throttle
between reading the text and writing the count, so editing or
save-and-resending the message in that window re-attached the previous
text's tokens with a fresh calculatedAt that kept them trusted
indefinitely. Results now carry a digest of the source projection and
the persister verifies it against the message's current text at apply
time, dropping mismatches so the analyzer re-enqueues the new text.

A worker-failure fallback was also persisted indistinguishable from an
exact encode: never retried, and displayed as precise. Fallback results
are now recorded in a persisted tokenCountApproximate entry — Context
and Total keep their ~ marker via isContextApproximate — and the
analyzer re-attempts an exact encode within a bounded per-run budget,
retrying afresh on the next launch. Edit paths clear the marker together
with the counts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: preserve async token retry lifecycle

* perf: benchmark long-draft tokenization

改为在布局阶段按实测尺寸摆位：右侧放不下且左侧更宽时翻到左侧，宽度和

* fix: keep mode menu sub-panel readable in narrow windows

窗口接近最小宽度时，主面板两侧已没有可用空间，按剩余空间收敛会把子面板
压成几像素宽，选项无法阅读。改为设置最小可用宽度，两侧都放不下时让子面板

* fix: place mode menu sub-panel against untransformed geometry

Popover 打开时有 200ms 的 scale 过渡，此时读到的 getBoundingClientRect
是被缩放过的，与 offsetHeight 等未变换的值混用会算出偏小的可用空间；
过渡结束后 transform 变化不会触发 ResizeObserver，错误位置会保留下来，
子面板仍可能越界。

行偏移改用 offsetTop，可用空间按当前缩放换算回面板自身坐标系，并在缩放
未收敛时于下一帧重新计算，直到过渡结束。

* fix: reposition mode menu sub-panel when the main panel resizes

主面板宽度是 w-max，知识库副标题等异步数据到达后会把主面板撑宽，此时子
面板自身尺寸没变，只观察子面板的 ResizeObserver 不会触发，之前基于旧
panelRect 算出的位置就可能越过视口边缘。

改为同时观察主面板与子面板。

commits.commit_title: fix: place copied sessions by repository order (#1156)
commits.commit_message:
fix: place copied sessions by repository order (#1156)

* fix: place copied sessions by repository order

Copying a session computed its sortOrder from the partially loaded
list window: a window ending at the source collided with the next
unloaded record's sortOrder (duplicated/dropped rows after the next
page fetch), a successor across the pin boundary lifted the copy above
the other pinned chats, and a source outside the window sent the copy
to the top of the list.

Neighbors now come from the session meta repository, restricted to the
source's pin group. When a created record still sorts to the tail of a
paginated window, the first page is reloaded from the repository so the
cached prefix stays contiguous.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: clear hidden records when placing a copied session

Hidden (archived) records keep their sortOrder, so a copy that lands on
one becomes a visible tie with unstable cross-page order once the record
is restored. The lower placement neighbor is now the nearest record in
the source's pin group, hidden records included.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.commit_title: fix: lock the composer on a tool-call-limit pause (#1151) (#1152)
commits.commit_message:
fix: lock the composer on a tool-call-limit pause (#1151) (#1152)

25 步上限暂停此前是唯一不锁输入框的暂停形式。原有理由是"消息仍可入队"，
但暂停时消息是以 generating: false 落盘的，getSubmitAction 因此走 'send'
而不是 'queue'：用户在暂停期间按下发送，会直接开启一轮新的生成，而
tool-flatten 会把 paused 的那批工具调用整段丢出上下文，模型看不到已经跑
过的 25 步；此时交互条仍挂着旧那轮的 Continue/Stop，之后点 Continue 会在
历史中间恢复一条 generating 消息。

消息队列层本来就用 currentConversationHasPausedToolCall 对所有暂停一视同仁
地推迟投递，只有输入框这道闸门是例外，现在对齐：

- 锁状态 awaitingToolApproval 改为 awaitingPauseDecision，由
  hasPendingPauseInteraction 派生，覆盖审批与步数上限两类暂停；阻塞原因
  相应改为 'awaiting-pause-decision'，文案复用「在下方交互条中响应。」
- PendingActionBar 去掉 takeover 开关：任何暂停都接管输入框那块位置，
  输入框保持挂载但隐藏，草稿、附件与自适应高度不受影响

(cherry picked from commit 4d3ceca650c9916ee407ca37dd725f370b0873f8)

commits.commit_title: fix(chat): preserve the original prompt when Save & Resend forks history (#1135)
commits.commit_message:
fix(chat): preserve the original prompt when Save & Resend forks history (#1135)

* fix(chat): preserve the original prompt when Save & Resend forks history

Save & Resend used to overwrite the edited message in place and fork at the
message itself; the stored branch only kept the tail after the pivot, so the
original prompt was lost and old replies re-appeared under a prompt they
never answered.

Version the message instead: buildSaveAndResendForkPatch stores
[original, ...old tail] as a branch under the predecessor (same pivot
convention as regenerateInNewFork, summaries skipped) and puts the edited
copy on the active path under a new id, in a single session write. Targets
without an eligible predecessor keep the legacy shape; a guard-blocked
resend still saves the edit in place so user text is never lost.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(forks): preview prompt-headed branches with their question and reply

Save & Resend branches now start with the original prompt instead of an
assistant reply, so the branch preview card renders the head message of any
role, pairs a user head with its first reply, and labels those cards Branch
instead of Reply. Prompt-only branches keep a preview instead of collapsing
into a follow-up count.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(session): keep shared RAG attachments alive across message versions

Versioned prompts reference the same indexed attachment row as the original,
but the row is owned by a single message id, so deleting the original (or the
branch holding it) took the row down while a live message still pointed at it.
Deleting a message or a fork branch now rebinds rows that survivors still
reference to one of those survivors before the owner-scoped delete and before
orphan maintenance sees them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(chat): save the edit when the Save & Resend session read fails

MessageEdit closes before the action runs, so a rejected session read inside
the generation lock discarded the user's text with the resend. The failure
path now falls back to an in-place save of the edited message.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(session-rag): keep referenced attachments through orphan maintenance

Save & Resend versioning lets several messages reference one indexed
attachment row while `message_id` records a single owner, so an owner
removal whose rebind did not land left the row reachable but unowned.
The orphan sweep now decides by reference: rows a live message still
claims are rebound, only unreferenced rows are deleted.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(chat): save the edit when the Save & Resend fork write fails

The editor closes as soon as it hands the edit over and void-calls the
action, so a rejected fork write took the user's text with it. Every
abort on the resend path now falls back to the same in-place save.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: document Save & Resend versioning as current behavior

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(chat): treat a durable Save & Resend fork as forked when metadata fails

The session write rejects on a failed list-metadata projection even
though the session data is already durable. On that path the branch
already holds the original prompt under its original id, so the caller's
in-place fallback would overwrite the archived prompt with the edited
text and skip the resend.

createSaveAndResendFork now tracks onFullSessionPersisted and reports
the fork instead of rejecting once the session is durable, so it only
rejects when nothing reached storage.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(chat): revert Reply Again Below to flat message inserts

「在下方回答」从创建 inactive fork 分支回退为平铺插入活跃路径：
候选回答重新成为普通消息（就地对比、可单独编辑删除），并发生成

  createInactiveFork 与 contextMessages 选项管线

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(core): add mode policy, freeze cross-mode switching, restrict work-mode message surgery

新增 @chatbox/core session/mode-policy：聊天/工作模式的静态能力策略
（与 action-gates 的临时锁语义分离——策略隐藏入口，锁禁用并提示）。

- 模式切换收口：会话产生首条用户消息后，手动 chat↔work 切换被拒绝
  （setSessionAgentMode 增加 source 参数；智能切换 accept/decline 与
  生成流内的 system 来源豁免；auto↔off 属聊天内部偏好不受影响）；
  模式面板双向对称禁用，复用既有 locked tooltip 文案
- 工作模式消息限制（UI 隐藏 + store 后备）：隐藏在下方回答、删除
  消息、删除分支入口；编辑仅保留用户消息且只有 Save & Resend
  （resendOnly 编辑弹窗：隐藏仅保存、锁定角色选择器、Ctrl+Enter
  映射为重发）

  per-row 订阅（大会话每 chunk 会全行跑 selector）

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(chat): disable message queue and steering in chat mode

聊天模式收起消息队列与 steering（工作模式保留）：

- getSubmitControl/getSubmitAction 增加 queueEnabled——聊天模式
  生成中控件保持 Stop、提交返回 block 并弹既有 generating 锁提示
- 存量已排队消息只出不进：queue-resume 在队列非空时保留，空闲发送
  不会插到旧队列项前面，队列「用户文本永不丢」不变量保持
- QueuedMessagesBar 在聊天模式隐藏「立即发送」插队入口（steering
  仅工作模式），队列条继续渲染直到 legacy 项排空
- 该阶段同时消掉两个跨机制语义洞：排队消息切分支后的跨分支投递
  歧义、steering 锚点被分支切换挪走的 MessageAnchorNotFoundError
  路径（聊天模式不再产生 steering，工作模式生成中禁切分支）

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(forks): allow branch switching during generation in chat mode

聊天模式下生成中允许切换分支（等待新回答时可翻看其他已完成回复）：

- switch-fork 门按 SessionActionContext.sessionMode 分化：chat 放开
  generating 锁，work 与未传模式的宿主（mobile-native）保守维持旧
  行为；compaction 边界锁与 delete-fork 的 generating 锁两模式不变
- guardSessionAction 统一注入会话模式，store 侧与 UI 预检同策略
- ForkGroup 拆分 switch/delete 两个门；含流式消息的非活跃分支强制
  reveal（切走时尾巴存回既有 list id，原「新 id 才展开」逻辑覆盖
  不到，且隐藏的流会失去卡片上的停止入口）
- 数据层无改动：流式写入按 id 全容器寻址、锁推导可达遍历、全局
  停止 runtime+可达图双保险、崩溃恢复全容器扫描，均为既有机制

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(chat): hide compaction summary edit/delete in work mode

Review feedback: the work-mode append-only policy covered ordinary
message rows but not SummaryMessage — the latest compaction summary
still exposed its plain-save editor and delete control, letting users
rewrite or drop historical model context in work mode.

SummaryMessage now takes the container-resolved sessionMode and gates
both controls through the same mode-policy actions as ordinary
messages (edit-assistant-message / delete-message).

* fix(forks): render live follow-up candidates inside revealed branches

A branch saved mid-stream can hold live candidates after a completed first

commits.commit_message:
fix: prevent mobile SQLite undefined writes and shiki unhandled rejections (#1129)

Mobile storage: JSON.stringify(undefined) yields the undefined value, which
crashed the 1.22.4 chunked writer at value.length before the bridge. Coerce
non-string serialization results to the JSON null literal (the pre-chunking
behavior), report the sanitized key class to Sentry so the caller can be
located in production, and guard SQLiteStorage.setItem with a descriptive
TypeError.

Shiki: the full-bundle loadLanguage wrapper throws synchronously for unknown
languages, bypassing the promise .catch() and turning every render into an
unhandled rejection. Route loading through an async wrapper, negative-cache
rejected languages, normalize casing/whitespace, and make highlight()/
preloadLanguage() degrade to plaintext or null instead of rejecting.

Tracked in issue 1125.

feat: add OpenCode Zen and Go gateway providers (#1104)

* feat: add OpenCode Go provider and document Cursor login limits

Add a built-in OpenCode Go gateway that authenticates with the official Zen API key and routes models to Responses, Anthropic Messages, or Chat Completions. Record why Cursor subscription OAuth cannot be shipped without an unofficial private chat API.

Co-authored-by: Zeng Xian <themezeng@gmail.com>

* fix(opencode-go): route Muse Spark to Responses and correct model metadata

muse-spark-1.2-contributor is served over /responses but fell through to
chat/completions. Switch routing to prefix rules so future ids in the same
families land on the right surface.

Also replace the hand-written DEFAULT_MODELS metadata with values from
models.dev: context windows were off by up to 5x (grok-4.5 256k -> 500k,
kimi-k3 200k -> 1.05M), every model was missing `reasoning`, and the
Kimi/Qwen/MiniMax/MiMo entries were missing `vision`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(opencode-zen): add the OpenCode Zen pay-as-you-go gateway

Zen and Go are two separate billed products on the same console: Zen is
pay-as-you-go over /zen/v1 with the full catalog (GPT / Claude / Gemini /
Grok plus open and free models), Go is the $10/month open-model
subscription over /zen/go/v1. Upstream names them `opencode/` and
`opencode-go/`, so Chatbox keeps both.

Zen needs a fourth surface Go does not have: Gemini is served straight off
<host>/models/<id> with an x-goog-api-key header, so the Gemini subclass
overrides getProvider() to drop the /v1beta suffix CustomGemini appends for
the public Google endpoint. Routing also differs per gateway (MiniMax is
chat/completions on Zen, Anthropic Messages on Go), so each provider keeps
its own prefix rules over the shared dispatch in opencode-shared.ts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
